newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-Jones unlikely to face Wellington.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-Jones unlikely to face Wellington.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Aug 18 - All Black lock and North Harbour captain Ian Jones is very likely to miss next Saturday's NPC rugby match with the Wellington Lions.
Jones ruptured an ear drum in Saturday's 36-24 test win over the Wallabies and his immediate future will be assessed by All Blacks doctor John Mayhew tomorrow.
The loss of Jones for North Harbour will be an immense one for the young team which lost to Counties-Manukau yesterday.
Wellington, playing Canterbury in Christchurch tonight without the injured All Blacks Alama Ieremia and Tana Umaga, will be glad of Jones' absence as Wellington must target North Harbour for a win.
"Depending on the assessment with John Mayhew, probably I'll be looking to not play against Wellington, and then we have a Friday night game with Auckland.
"That's something I have to talk about with (coach) Peter Thorburn and see how I go," Jones said.
Jones said he would have no trouble getting motivated for the NPC despite playing 11 Super 12 matches and eight tests since March 1.
"The captaincy is something I'm going to relish, and North Harbour's got a team of young, eager players, a lot of them in their first year.
"It will be good to be part of that and give North Harbour a springboard for years to come."
